newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL BANK/GREECE TO CUT DEPO RATE BY 50BPS SEPT 2.
newsitem.headline: NATL BANK/GREECE TO CUT DEPO RATE BY 50BPS SEPT 2.

text.p: The National Bank of Greece will cut its base deposit rate by 50 basis points to 11.50 percent and its lending rate for working capital by 100 basis points to 17.75 percent effective September 2, it said in a statement.
It will also slash its consumer, personal and credit card loan rates by 50 basis points to 24 percent, 25 percent and 26.5 percent respectively, it said.
The lending rate for fixed assets will be cut by 50 basis points to 16.5 percent and the adjustable-rate mortgages by 50 basis points to 15.5 percent, it said.
The current account deposit rate will also be reduced by half a percentage point to 10 percent, it said.
